identity.name: Dadeldhura Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Dadeldhura Multiple Campus is a constituent campus of Tribhuvan University located in Dadeldhura district, Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal.
identity.description: Dadeldhura Multiple Campus is one of the premier higher education institutions in the Sudurpashchim Province of Nepal. As a constituent campus of Tribhuvan University, it offers various undergraduate and graduate programs in Humanities, Management, and Education, catering to the educational needs of students in the far-western region.
